name_reason: fd2_ prefix correct (game function); descriptor 'restore_block_loop' accurately reflects the inner copy loop for a screen-block restore. No Ghidra address residue. Consistent with its mirror fd2_save_block_loop @ 0x4E9A0 and the rest of the blit-primitive family in blitspr.c, which use fd2_<descriptor> without an explicit graphics domain token.
purpose: Inner copy loop for screen-block restore: copies a width x height pixel block from a contiguous source buffer to a strided destination, one row at a time.
logic_summary: row_remain = data_fd2_graphics_rle_blit_remaining_rows (0x627B6, height). Outer do/while over rows: each iteration reloads col_remain = data_fd2_graphics_rle_blit_cur_width (0x627B4, width) at the top of the row, memmoves col_remain bytes src->dst (binary REP MOVSB; both src and a temp dst-iter advance), then src += col_remain (src runs continuously across rows) and dst += stride (dst from the row start steps to the next row), row_remain--; loops while row_remain != 0. Width is re-read every row (binary loops back to MOV CX,[0x627B4]); height read once. Post-test loop, so height 0 still paints one row. In the binary src/dst/stride arrive in registers (ESI/EDI/EBP) seeded by the sole caller; exposed as explicit params in C for portability.
signature: void fd2_restore_block_loop(uint32 dst, uint32 src, uint32 stride)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row start of the block being restored); carried in EDI in the binary, advanced by stride each row.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller's resolved destination pointer (restore_dst). No address residue.

params.name: src
params.semantics: Source pixel data: contiguous width*height saved bytes (saved_block + 8); carried in ESI in the binary, runs continuously across rows.
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller's src cursor. No address residue.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance the destination per row; carried in EBP in the binary (added to dst each row via ADD EDI,EBP).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches caller's stride argument. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the row-by-row block copy as a side effect on the destination buffer. Binary ends with plain RET (the loop is reached via CALL from the outer setter).
